race.comment: MAD ABOUT MAGNUS (6) resumes as the horse to beat, with a Pakenham trial win two weeks ago giving a positive pointer and a 1000m record of two wins and one placing from four starts. Form in her maiden campaign reads well for this when tested in better company and she should give a sight with Lane booked. BEL LUPA (10) looks the main danger third-up after starting favourite and running fourth at this track, beaten two and a half lengths, and her prior win over this route reads well. MR TICKLES (1) is flying after BM56 and BM66 wins, the latest at Sale at big odds, and Hayley Spitse has an excellent record on him. Big weight but will give a sight. HELLO ROMEO (2) was beaten by MR TICKLES first-up but had a wide run and has prior form that measures up. Can be fitter now and peg back the margin. BIFROST (5) is consistent and an each-way hope again.
